# Wishlist — raw notes

## Problem

Shoppers lose track of items they are not ready to buy yet.

## Users

Shoppers on the storefront.

## What the feature does

Keeps picked items on a list of their own, and moves one into the cart.

## Out of scope

Sharing a list with another shopper.
